relations.label: mp_supports
relations.description:
### Definition
`mp_supports` is the positive argumentative relation corresponding to `mp:supports`. It links a supporting Representation to the Representation whose proposition, evidential role, or argument graph it affirmatively supports.

### Direction
supporting Representation -> `mp_supports` -> supported Representation.

### Extract when
Emit only when the passage explicitly or unambiguously expresses positive evidential/argumentative backing (e.g. supports, demonstrates, confirms, provides evidence for, is consistent with, indicates/suggests in an argumentative context). Mere co-occurrence, citation, method use, or data production does not by itself imply `mp_supports`.

### Allowed schema patterns
Use only source-target type combinations present in `potential_schema`. In this BAE schema these include Attribution -> Representation; Reference -> Claim/Statement when the cited source is used as backing; DataSet -> Claim/Statement; Statement -> Claim; Claim -> Claim; and ScienceEvidence -> Claim/Statement/SupportGraph.

### Example
“The measured decrease in grain MeHg supports the conclusion that modified biochar reduces Hg bioavailability.” -> DataSet/ScienceEvidence `mp_supports` Claim.

relations.label: whu_declaredUsed
relations.description:
### Definition
Links a `whu_ResearchStep` to a Method, Device, Reagent, or Software explicitly stated as used in that step.

### Direction
ResearchStep -> `whu_declaredUsed` -> Method/Device/Reagent/Software.

### Extract when
Emit only when the text assigns the resource to the specific step. Do not attach a resource to an Experiment-level node when the using ResearchStep can be identified.

### Example
“Hg was measured by CVAFS using an F-732 analyzer.” -> ResearchStep declaredUsed Method[CVAFS] and Device[F-732].

relations.label: p_plan_correspondsToStep
relations.description:
### Definition
Corresponds to P-PLAN `correspondsToStep`: links an explicitly executed provenance activity to the plan-level/textual `whu_ResearchStep` it realizes.

### Extraction policy
This relation is reserved for an external provenance/execution stage that supplies a `prov:Activity` (e.g. run log, execution timestamp, instrument-run identifier). It is not emitted from ordinary Methods prose when only the described ResearchStep is available.

### Direction
prov:Activity -> `p_plan_correspondsToStep` -> whu:ResearchStep.

relations.label: prov_atLocation
relations.description:
### Definition
`prov_atLocation` associates an explicitly locatable entity or recorded research step with the environmental/site feature at which it is located or occurs.

### Allowed schema patterns
- `obi_organism -> prov_atLocation -> whu_EnvironmentFeature`
- `whu_ResearchStep -> prov_atLocation -> whu_EnvironmentFeature`

### Extract when
Emit only when the passage explicitly identifies the relevant site/environment for the organism or ResearchStep. Prefer `whu_hasContext` for linking a SpecimenCollection Plan to its broader environmental context.

### Example
“Topsoil was sampled from the SWU paddy field.” -> ResearchStep[sampling] atLocation EnvironmentFeature[SWU paddy field].

relations.label: cito_isCitedBy
relations.description:
### Definition
`cito_isCitedBy` corresponds to CiTO `cito:isCitedBy`, the inverse of `cito:cites`. In this schema, the subject is the cited `mp_References` source and the object is the Representation that cites that source.

### Direction
Reference (cited source) -> `cito_isCitedBy` -> Claim/Statement/DataSet/Method (citing Representation).

### Extract when
Emit when the text explicitly ties the Representation to an identifiable citation. Do not infer `mp_supports` from citation alone; add support only when the citation is used as evidential backing.

### Example
“Biochar reduces Hg bioavailability (Smith et al., 2020).” -> Reference[Smith et al., 2020] isCitedBy Statement/Claim.

relations.label: whu_hasGoal
relations.description:
### Definition
Links a BioChemical or Computational Experiment to an explicitly stated scientific Goal.

### Direction
BioChemical_Experiment/Computational_Experiment -> `whu_hasGoal` -> Goal.

### Extract when
Use explicit objective language such as “to quantify”, “to assess”, “to compare”, “to determine”, or “to predict”. Do not infer a Goal from general background motivation.

relations.label: p_plan_isPrecededBy
relations.description:
### Definition
Standard P-PLAN ordering relation used between `whu_ResearchStep` instances.

### Direction
later/downstream ResearchStep -> `p_plan_isPrecededBy` -> earlier/upstream ResearchStep.

### Extract when
Emit for explicit temporal/logical ordering cues (after, following, then, subsequently, before) or an unambiguous immediate dependency between recorded steps.

### Example
“After sieving, samples were digested.” -> ResearchStep[digestion] isPrecededBy ResearchStep[sieving].

relations.label: whu_fellow
relations.description:
### Definition
`whu_fellow(X,Y)` is the BAE mid-level adjacency/dependency relation: Y is the immediate upstream predecessor or provider for X.

### Direction
downstream/later X -> `whu_fellow` -> upstream/earlier Y.

### Allowed signatures
1. SpecimenPreprocessing -> SpecimenCollection
2. BioChemical_Experiment -> SpecimenPreprocessing
3. Computational_Experiment -> BioChemical_Experiment
4. BioChemical_Experiment -> BioChemical_Experiment
5. Computational_Experiment -> Computational_Experiment

### Extract when
Use explicit temporal/dependency evidence or a clear shared-output/input transition. Do not use `whu_fellow` to connect SpecimenCollection with EnvironmentFeature; that contextual link is represented by `whu_hasContext`.

### Direction rule
“X follows/depends on Y” is always X -> `whu_fellow` -> Y.

### Example
“After sample preprocessing, Hg was determined by CVAFS.” -> BioChemical_Experiment fellow SpecimenPreprocessing.

relations.label: whu_hasTarget
relations.description:
### Definition
Links a research Goal to the specific TargetVariable toward which the goal is directed.

### Direction
Goal -> `whu_hasTarget` -> TargetVariable.

### Extract when
The target quantity is explicitly named or unambiguously recoverable from the stated objective.

### Example
“The experiment aimed to quantify Hg concentration.” -> Goal hasTarget TargetVariable[Hg concentration].

relations.label: p_plan_isInputVarOf
relations.description:
### Definition
Plan-level shortcut relation corresponding to P-PLAN `isInputVarOf`, used in this extraction schema to connect a concrete Specimen or ProcessedSpecimen directly to the Plan/Experiment for which it serves as input.

### Purpose
This is a plan-level projection that skips the intermediate ResearchStep for concise retrieval and MetaPath construction. The detailed step-level input relation remains `ResearchStep -> whu_declaredInput -> domain entity`.

### Direction
input entity -> `p_plan_isInputVarOf` -> Plan/Experiment.

### Allowed schema patterns
- Specimen -> SpecimenPreprocessing
- ProcessedSpecimen -> BioChemical_Experiment

### Extract when
Emit only when the passage directly supports that the entity is used as input to the named preprocessing/experiment module.

### Example
“Processed powder was used for ICP-MS analysis.” -> ProcessedSpecimen `p_plan_isInputVarOf` BioChemical_Experiment.

relations.label: p_plan_isOutputVarOf
relations.description:
### Definition
Plan-level shortcut relation corresponding to P-PLAN `isOutputVarOf`, used in this extraction schema to connect a concrete output entity directly to the Plan/Experiment that produces it.

### Purpose
This is a plan-level projection that skips the intermediate ResearchStep for concise retrieval and MetaPath construction. The detailed step-level output relation remains `ResearchStep -> whu_declaredOutput -> domain entity`.

### Direction
output entity -> `p_plan_isOutputVarOf` -> Plan/Experiment.

### Allowed schema patterns
- Specimen -> SpecimenCollection
- ProcessedSpecimen -> SpecimenPreprocessing
- DataSet -> Computational_Experiment

### Extract when
Emit only when the text directly supports that the entity is an output of the corresponding plan/experiment module.

### Example
“The preprocessing produced a filtered digest.” -> ProcessedSpecimen `p_plan_isOutputVarOf` SpecimenPreprocessing.

relations.label: prov_wasDerivedFrom
relations.description:
### Definition
`prov_wasDerivedFrom` records material/provenance derivation between a resulting entity and its source entity.

### Allowed schema patterns
- Specimen -> EnvironmentFeature
- Specimen -> envo_EnvironmentMaterial
- Specimen -> obi_organism
- ProcessedSpecimen -> Specimen

### Extraction rule
Use the most specific source explicitly supported by the passage. A Specimen may derive from the environmental feature/site as a whole, from a specific environmental material within it, or from a living organism. Do not invent a more specific source than the text provides.

### Examples
“Soil samples were collected from the paddy field.” -> Specimen wasDerivedFrom EnvironmentFeature[paddy field] when only the site is explicit.
“Soil samples were taken from surface soil.” -> Specimen wasDerivedFrom EnvironmentMaterial[surface soil].
“Rice grain was sampled from rice plants.” -> Specimen wasDerivedFrom organism[rice plant].

relations.label: dcterms_hasPart
relations.description:
### Definition
Uses `dcterms:hasPart` to represent a DataSet containing one or more `iao_DataItem` records.

### Direction
DataSet -> `dcterms_hasPart` -> DataItem.

### Extraction note
`iao_ScalarMeasurementDatum` is a subtype of DataItem. If the extraction runtime types a member specifically as ScalarMeasurementDatum, do not create an additional duplicate generic DataItem node solely to satisfy this relation.

relations.label: mp_challenges
relations.description:
### Definition
`mp_challenges` is the negative argumentative relation corresponding to `mp:challenges`. It links a challenging Representation to the Representation whose proposition or argument graph it contradicts, refutes, weakens, or undermines.

### Direction
challenging Representation -> `mp_challenges` -> challenged Representation.

### Extract when
Emit only when contradiction/challenge is explicit or unambiguous (e.g. contradicts, refutes, does not support, inconsistent with, fails to confirm, undermines). Absence of support is not automatically a challenge.

### Allowed schema patterns
Use only source-target combinations present in `potential_schema`, including DataSet -> Claim/Statement, Statement -> Claim, Claim -> Claim, and ScienceEvidence -> Claim/Statement/SupportGraph.

### Example
“The observed lack of treatment effect contradicts the proposed mechanism.” -> DataSet/ScienceEvidence challenges Claim/Statement.

relations.label: iao_is_about
relations.description:
### Definition
`iao_is_about` expresses aboutness between an information-content entity and the entity or variable it describes.

### Allowed schema patterns
Resource-oriented aboutness:
- DataSet -> Reagent
- DataSet -> Specimen
- DataSet -> ProcessedSpecimen

Target-variable aboutness:
- TargetVariable -> ChemicalEntity
- DataSet -> TargetVariable
- DataItem -> TargetVariable
- ScalarMeasurementDatum -> TargetVariable

### Granularity rule
Choose the pairing that matches the text's actual semantic granularity. Do not force extraction to TargetVariable when the passage only states that a dataset concerns a reagent or specimen, and do not replace a specific TargetVariable link with a broader resource link when the measured variable is explicit. Multiple aboutness links may coexist when independently supported.

### Examples
“The dataset reports responses of rice grain samples to selenium treatment.” -> DataSet is_about Specimen[rice grain] and, when explicitly represented, Reagent[selenium treatment].
“The dataset reflects Hg content.” -> DataSet is_about TargetVariable[Hg content].
“Mean Hg content was 28.4 ng/g.” -> ScalarMeasurementDatum[28.4 ng/g] is_about TargetVariable[Hg content].
“Hg content” -> TargetVariable[Hg content] is_about ChemicalEntity[Hg].

properties.name: whu_is_about_dimension
properties.description: Optional controlled measurement-dimension tag for the aboutness relation. Choose only from an implementation-controlled vocabulary such as mass, volume, count, concentration, mass_concentration, molar_concentration, absorbance, intensity, ratio, rate, pH, conductivity, or turbidity. Assign only when the dimension is explicit or unambiguous from the reported unit/measure; otherwise omit.

relations.label: p_plan_isStepOfPlan
relations.description:
### Definition
Standard P-PLAN membership relation associating a `whu_ResearchStep` with the mid-level Plan/Experiment that organizes it.

### Allowed targets
SpecimenCollection, SpecimenPreprocessing, BioChemical_Experiment, or Computational_Experiment.

### Direction
ResearchStep -> `p_plan_isStepOfPlan` -> Plan/Experiment.

### Constraint
The target must be consistent with `WHU_RESEARCHTYPE`.

relations.label: prov_hadMember
relations.description:
### Definition
PROV-O collection-membership relation used to aggregate components into BAE evidence and argumentation collections.

### Allowed schema patterns
- ScienceEvidence -> DataSet
- ScienceEvidence -> Method
- SupportGraph -> Claim
- SupportGraph -> Statement
- SupportGraph -> Attribution
- SupportGraph -> Reference
- SupportGraph -> ScienceEvidence

### Semantics
This relation encodes membership only. It does not encode positive/negative argumentative polarity; use `mp_supports` or `mp_challenges` for polarity.

### Example
ScienceEvidence hadMember DataSet; ScienceEvidence hadMember Method.

relations.label: bfo_has_part
relations.description:
### Definition
BFO mereological relation used when one material/environmental entity physically contains another as a part.

### Allowed schema patterns
- EnvironmentFeature -> EnvironmentMaterial
- Specimen -> ChemicalEntity
- organism -> ChemicalEntity
- EnvironmentMaterial -> ChemicalEntity

### Extract when
Emit only when the passage supports a part/constituent relation. Do not use `bfo_has_part` for mere location, provenance, or analytical aboutness.

relations.label: whu_declaredInput
relations.description:
### Definition
BAE-defined relation linking a ResearchStep directly to an actual domain entity explicitly functioning as that step's input.

### Direction
ResearchStep -> `whu_declaredInput` -> Specimen/ProcessedSpecimen/DataSet.

### Extraction policy
BAE reuses P-PLAN for Plan/Step organization and ordering; domain-specific input/output entities are connected through `whu_declaredInput`/`whu_declaredOutput`. Emit only when the input role is textually supported.

### Example
“Air-dried soil was sieved before digestion.” -> ResearchStep[sieving] declaredInput Specimen[air-dried soil].

relations.label: whu_declaredOutput
relations.description:
### Definition
BAE-defined relation linking a ResearchStep directly to an actual domain entity explicitly generated or produced by that step.

### Direction
ResearchStep -> `whu_declaredOutput` -> Specimen/ProcessedSpecimen/DataSet.

### Extract when
Emit only when the passage supports an output/product relation for the specific step.

### Example
“Hg was measured by CVAFS.” -> ResearchStep[Hg measurement] declaredOutput DataSet[Hg measurements].

relations.label: whu_hasContext
relations.description:
### Definition
BAE-defined relation linking a SpecimenCollection Plan to the environmental feature that provides its explicit sampling/research context.

### Direction
SpecimenCollection -> `whu_hasContext` -> EnvironmentFeature.

### Extract when
Emit when the collection procedure is explicitly tied to a bounded environmental setting/site. Use `prov_atLocation` for the location of a particular ResearchStep or organism.

### Example
“Topsoil samples were collected from the SWU paddy field.” -> SpecimenCollection hasContext EnvironmentFeature[SWU paddy field].
